People around Sam often share different ideas about the green hill. On Saturday evenings, Sam reviews the notes from class. Sam bought a dress online because it was much cheaper. What's more, cows graze in the meadow by the river.

Little by little, things began to change. Lily always says that small steps matter more than big plans. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. For example, the earth goes around the sun.

Sam believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. The experience taught Sam more than any book could. Sam will take part in a basketball match in November. Best of all, the sprinkler ticks in circles at dawn.
The city park has become an important part of daily life. Sam prefers snowy weather when running in the park. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Also, the cold frame hardens salads off.
At first, Sam found it difficult to keep the habit. Sam thanked Lily for the honest advice. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right.
